description:
Reproject the Natural Earth countries layer from WGS 84 (Geographic) to Web Mercator (EPSG:3857) and save it as a new shapefile.

gvSIG Desktop is open with the 'ne_110m_admin_0_countries' layer loaded. The current View is in EPSG:4326 (WGS 84). Your task is to perform a permanent coordinate transformation on the data, not just change the view projection.

Steps:
1. Use the Geoprocessing tools (Tools > Geoprocessing > Toolbox) OR the Export functionality to reproject the layer.
2. Locate the 'Reproject' algorithm (under Vector > Geospatial data management) or right-click the layer > Export > to SHP.
3. Configure the target CRS to EPSG:3857 (Search for '3857' or 'Pseudo-Mercator' or 'WGS 84 / Pseudo-Mercator').
4. Save the result as a new shapefile at: /home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/countries_mercator.shp

The task is complete when the new shapefile exists and its coordinates are in meters (Web Mercator projection).
